preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100000 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Length of each string s is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == '-1' or (output_line.split() == list(map(str, range(1, len(s) + 1))) and len(set(output_line.split())) == len(s)) for output_line, s in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' indicating no valid permutation exists, or a permutation of numbers from 1 to n without repetition.

postconditions.expression: all(is_palindrome(apply_permutation(s, map(int, output_line.split()))) if output_line != '-1' else True for output_line, s in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: If the output line is not '-1', applying the permutation to the string s results in a palindromic string.
